classification.description: 🥧 HTTPie CLI  — modern, user-friendly command-line HTTP client for the API era. JSON support, colors, sessions, downloads, plugins & more.

plan.architecture_summary: HTTPie is a popular, user-friendly command-line HTTP client written in Python. The codebase is organized into modules handling CLI arguments, networking requests via requests, formatting and coloring outputs, session management, and plugins. Testing is done via pytest, with a Makefile providing convenient setup and task runners.

key_directories.purpose: Main Python source code package for HTTPie CLI

setup_steps.title: Set up development environment and install dependencies
setup_steps.detail: Creates a venv in ./venv, installs dev/test requirements and HTTPie in editable mode, and runs tests.

setup_steps.title: Activate virtual environment
setup_steps.detail: Activates the Python virtual environment for your shell session.

setup_steps.title: Run test suite
setup_steps.detail: Runs the pytest test suite locally.

setup_steps.title: Check code style
setup_steps.detail: Runs flake8 to verify PEP8 compliance.

commit: Consider adding a CHANGELOG entry for changes.
pull_request: PRs introducing code changes must include tests and documentation.
Check that all CI checks pass on GitHub Actions.
code_style: make codestyle (uses flake8 for PEP8 compliance)

issues.title: Bug: log_error ignores --quiet flag when stdout is redirected
issues.why: A clear-cut bug report with a specific context method involved, ideal for a Python beginner willing to write a test and fix.
issues.approach: Investigate httpie/context.py where log_error checks if stdout is a tty or if quiet flags are set, and ensure --quiet correctly suppresses warnings or logs when stdout is redirected. Add a regression test in tests/ to verify the behavior.

issues.title: A JSON body that starts with a brace can be parsed from the middle
issues.why: A localized Python bug involving regex parsing with a clear reproduction script provided in the issue description.
issues.approach: Examine httpie/output/utils.py and the prefix regex/parsing logic in load_prefixed_json to ensure that the match starts at the beginning of the string rather than anywhere in the middle. Add unit tests for prefixed JSON parsing.

issues.title: Public search engines do not preview doc strings with italicized/bolded text correctly
issues.why: A straightforward documentation/markup fix suitable for a newcomer's first contribution.
issues.approach: Update docs/README.md or relevant documentation files to correct markdown formatting, text representation, or doc strings so that public search engines or rendering engines display text correctly.

first_timer_insights: Successful first-time PRs often involve concise documentation updates, fish shell completion additions, or small bug fixes with tests.
Files modified in recent PRs include docs/README.md, extras/httpie-completion.fish, and python modules under httpie/.
caveats: Repo activity is currently low/inactive, but issues and pull requests are still welcomed.
Some issues might require specific OS environments or design decisions.
